title.en: An Act Renaming the Whole Stretch of Road Starting from the Junction of Barangay Bagong Sikat including Liboro Street up to Barangay Caminawit Pier in the Municipality of San Jose, Province of Occidental Mindoro as Bishop Felix Y. Manalo Avenue

text.en: In recognition of the eminent and spiritual services of the late Bishop Felix Y. Manalo, religious founder of the Iglesia Ni Cristo, the whole stretch of road starting from the Junction of Barangay Bagong Sikat up to Barangay Caminawit Pier in the Municipal;ity of San Jose, Province of Occidental Mindoro is hereby renamed as Bishop Felix Y. Manalo Avenue.
The Department of Public Works and Highways is hereby instructed to place the appropriate markers along Bishop Felix Y. Manalo Avenue.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
